name: Linn County, IA
findings: Linn County has 870 nonprofit organizations. 265 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 217 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Linn County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Linn County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 54 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Foundation organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 9 foundation organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do foundation organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?
